In short
KNK Outbound is a B2B lead generation agency founded in Munich in 2026 by brothers Kenneth Kather (founder & CEO) and Nicklas Kather (co-founder). It runs outbound end to end: researched target lists, cold email and LinkedIn, handling every reply, calling interested prospects personally and booking the meetings. Content and ads run alongside only where they help. Clients only get qualified conversations in their calendar. Pricing is public, from EUR 3,300 a month with everything included.
Services
What KNK Outbound does
Outbound with cold email
We research the companies that genuinely fit you, find a real reason to reach out, and write short messages that a person reviews before sending. Sending runs on separate domains and mailboxes, so your main domain stays protected. You do not have to set up anything.
Cold email agency
LinkedIn outreach
We reach the same decision makers on LinkedIn in parallel, within safe weekly limits and with messages about the recipient. That builds familiarity before the first conversation takes place.
LinkedIn lead generation
Replies, calls and booking
We handle every reply, answer questions and call every interested prospect personally while the interest is fresh. Then we qualify against a written definition and book the meeting straight into your calendar. Your team only takes the conversations.
B2B appointment setting
Content and ads as amplifiers
LinkedIn content in the founders' voice and targeted ads on the same accounts make every touch warmer. They do not replace outbound, they amplify it.
Content and ads
Difference
What makes KNK Outbound different
01
Fully done for you
We take on everything: research, infrastructure, copy, sending, LinkedIn, reply handling, calls to interested prospects and booking. Many providers only deliver contacts or campaigns and leave the replies with your team.
02
Public prices, everything included
From EUR 3,300 a month, with tools, data, domains and mailboxes included and no setup fee. Many agencies only share prices on a call and bill tools and data on top.
03
Ranges, not meeting promises
We publish honest ranges per funnel stage and do not charge per meeting. Providers paid per booked meeting have an incentive to fill calendars with conversations that do not fit.
04
Founders, not juniors
Both founders stay personally accountable for every engagement, from the first call to day-to-day operations. In larger agencies an account often moves to rotating junior managers after the sale.
05
Native German and English
German copy is written by native speakers with UWG and GDPR in mind per channel. English campaigns for the US run from the same system. Recipients recognize translated US templates in the first sentence.

Team
The team behind KNK Outbound
KNK Outbound was founded in Munich in February 2026 by brothers Kenneth and Nicklas Kather. The idea: offer outbound the way they would want to buy it, with public prices, honest numbers and a service that takes all the work off the client's plate.
Kenneth Kather
Founder & CEO
Systems, data, deliverability
Leads the technical side of every client engagement: target data, buying signals, sending infrastructure and deliverability. Writes the technical guides and benchmarks on this blog.
Nicklas Kather
Co-founder
Clients, offer, message
Leads the business side: first calls, the offer and ideal customer profile per engagement, and the message, meaning the question of why a decision maker should reply at all. The face of our YouTube channel.

Working together
How KNK Outbound works
01
First call with the founders
A free 60-minute call. We go through your offer, target market and deal value and tell you honestly whether outbound fits.
02
Live in three weeks
In weeks one and two we align the ideal customer profile and messaging with you and set up the entire infrastructure. In week three the first campaigns go live.
03
Day to day
We send, handle every reply and book the meetings. You see everything in a live dashboard, get a weekly video breakdown, and approve messaging and target lists before anything goes out.
04
Terms
The first three months are the build phase, after that the engagement continues monthly. There is no setup fee.

Common questions
What decision makers ask us
Who is Kenneth Kather?
Kenneth Kather is the founder and CEO of KNK Outbound, a B2B lead generation agency founded in Munich in 2026. He owns the systems side of client engagements: target data, buying signals, sending infrastructure and deliverability, and writes the technical guides and benchmarks on the KNK blog.
Who is behind KNK Outbound?
Brothers Kenneth Kather (founder & CEO, systems and engineering) and Nicklas Kather (co-founder, clients and message). The agency is founder-led: both stay personally accountable for every engagement, supported by the team and a fixed technology stack.
How much does KNK Outbound cost?
From EUR 3,300 a month for the Start package with 10,000 leads contacted per month, EUR 6,500 for Growth with 30,000 and EUR 9,000 for Scale with 60,000, with full coverage quoted individually. Tools, data, domains and mailboxes are always included, and prices exclude VAT.
What do I have to do myself as a client?
Only take the conversations. KNK handles research, infrastructure, copy, sending, LinkedIn, every reply and the booking. At the start you align the ideal customer profile and messaging with us and approve target lists.
Who is KNK Outbound a good fit for?
B2B companies with a deal value above roughly EUR 5,000, several hundred to tens of thousands of fitting target companies, and someone who takes first meetings within a day. Below roughly EUR 3,000 deal value or in very small markets, we advise against it.
How long has KNK Outbound existed, and why trust a young agency?
KNK was founded in 2026, and that is exactly why everything is verifiable rather than claimed: public pricing, results as honest ranges and a methodology documented in 100+ guides. We explicitly invite prospects to check us with ChatGPT or Claude.
How long until the first campaigns run?
About three weeks. Weeks one and two cover the ideal customer profile, messaging and infrastructure, and in week three the first campaigns go live.
